forecast_obs_notes: Model agreement is poor, with a roughly 15°F spread between the coldest and warmest guidance: NBM forecasts ~68°F and GFS runs very warm at ~83.3°F, while ECMWF (~75°F), HRRR (~78.5°F), and Weather.com (~73.8°F) cluster in the middle. This level of cross-model divergence significantly undermines confidence in any single temperature target.
max_temp_prediction: The full ensemble expected TMAX is 73.7°F (forecast-only model: 76.8°F), and the prior-day observed high was 71.6°F, suggesting modest warming Sunday. However, the ensemble probability distribution is extremely flat — six consecutive 2°F buckets from 68–79°F each carry ~20% probability with zero gap between them — indicating the model cannot meaningfully discriminate between those outcomes. Both even and odd bucket sets are rated Tier 4 (Poor Signals — AVOID) with only 32% expected accuracy, making confident directional bets inadvisable.
